dialogues.text:
Hello.
I represent Time Life Corporation. I'm here to apply for a time-credit loan.

Certainly.
How much time credit are you seeking?
Will this time credit be used for corporate operations?

Yes.
Primarily for project expansion and personnel allocation.

Repayment will be deducted from the company's future time revenue.
Do you confirm that you understand the relevant terms?
All right. Your corporate time-loan application meets the requirements, but I need to review the documents you submit before proceeding.
(Hands over the documents) Of course. Here are my documents.

notes.content:

final_dialogues.text: After reviewing your documents, the Corporate Time Loan has been approved.
(Looking down at the confirmation notice.) That was approved faster than I expected.
The time credits will be released within the stated timeframe.
Then the project can keep moving forward.
Please note that regular operating reports are required while the corporate time credits are in use.
Things are probably going to get very busy.
As the person in charge, you'll also need to take part in the follow-up allocation of time.
The loan is approved, and I'll be the first one working overtime.
Of course, everyone will be busier.
But this is the company's choice.
I hope the project goes well.
